page.layout: One page of text: running head at top centre; heading in two lines below it; a woodcut engraving in the middle; a verse epigram in italic below the engraving, with a large initial L; catchword "Luna" at the lower right.

main_text.head: Luna Soli oppofita, & interiectu terræ deficiens. XXXVII.

p.i: Vnam interueniens ceu terra corpus opacum

page.notes: The woodcut shows the sun at left, the earth at centre within a circle, and the moon at upper right of the earth, with clouds and landscape; it is an engraving and is not transcribed as text. The initial L of the epigram is a large decorative letter, joined to the first word as "Vnam". The heading has "interiectu" as printed, with the ligature-like spelling of the scan; "interiectu" and "XXXVII" are read from the scan and may be imperfect.
